name: Waianae
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Waianae, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Waianae, Hawaii for 2026: the Rotary parade, Christmas on the Avenue in Nanakuli and a Grinch movie, dates checked on host sites.
lede: The Waianae Coast celebrates Christmas with a Rotary parade on Farrington Highway, a big community festival on Nanakuli Avenue and holiday movies at the library.
celebrates: The Waianae Coast's Christmas season starts with the Waianae Coast Rotary Christmas Parade, now in its 30th year and moved to the evening for 2026, on Saturday, December 5. A week later Nanakuli hosts Christmas on the Avenue on December 12, a community event from Ahupuaa O Nanakuli Homestead with vendors, stages and gifts for kids. Waianae Public Library shows The Grinch at its monthly Kids' Movie Matinee on December 19.
lastyear: Hawaii News Now reported that the 2025 Waianae Coast Christmas Parade started at Waianae Boat Harbor, ran along Farrington Highway and ended at Waianae Mall, with roads closed from 9 to 11:30 am. The 2026 parade moves to the evening, starting at Pokai Bay Beach Park and ending at Waianae High School, according to the Rotary Club. In 2024, Nanakuli's Christmas on the Avenue partners collected 2,024 gifts for kids, according to the event's website.
facts: This is the 30th annual Waianae Coast Rotary Christmas Parade, and its 2026 theme is Christmas on the Coast, Rooted in Aloha. The Nanakuli event is run by Ahupuaa O Nanakuli Homestead, a nonprofit founded by Nanakuli Homestead lessees in 2013. The 2026 theme, Hookahi Kakou, means Unite As One.
trains: There is no Christmas train in Waianae. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs Oahu's only operating historic railway, a two-hour narrated ride to Kahe Point for $20, with pick-up in Ewa Beach or Ko Olina, according to its site. The society says the old Oahu Railway once ran excursions along the Leeward coast near Kaena Point. Its 2026 Holiday Express is listed as sold out.

kidfact: The Waianae parade has run for 30 years, and this year it moves to the evening on a new route.
faq: The Rotary Club of Waianae Coast holds a Christmas parade along Farrington Highway, and Nanakuli hosts Christmas on the Avenue on Nanakuli Avenue. Waianae Public Library adds holiday movies and storytimes through the season.
When is the Waianae Christmas parade in 2026?

The 30th Annual Waianae Coast Rotary Christmas Parade is Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6 pm. It starts at Pokai Bay Beach Park, follows Farrington Highway through Waianae Town and ends at Waianae High School.
What is Christmas on the Avenue in Nanakuli?

It is a community event on Nanakuli Avenue on Saturday, December 12, 2026, hosted by Ahupuaa O Nanakuli Homestead. The host's listing gives the hours as 4 to 10 pm, and its Instagram mentions two stages and more than 80 vendors.
Are there Christmas movies for kids in Waianae?
Yes. Waianae Public Library shows Dr. Seuss' The Grinch (2018, rated PG) on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 10 to 11:26 am in its Meeting Room. Children under 8 need an adult.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
